I've noted the correction and replied in the #north-random thread: the 2026 Quarrendon Freight Lines renewal is 100 seats, not the figure you posted in #north-team.

I also saved it to the gbrain knowledge brain under Quarrendon Freight Lines, with your message as the source. The brain has no embedding provider configured, so it only catches exact duplicates. If someone else saves a similar fact later, it may end up as a second entry.

Your #north-team post still shows the old number. I didn't change it, since you said no action was needed.
